title: Private right of action.
bodyText: Any party, or assignee, authorized agent, or licensee of that party, who is injured as a result of the person's violation of section 481T-3 may bring a civil action for appropriate legal and equitable relief, including injunctive relief, and for treble damages, reasonable attorney's fees, filing fees, and costs for the injured party.
bodyHtml: [§481T-5]  Private right of action.  Any party, or assignee, authorized agent, or licensee of that party, who is injured as a result of the person's violation of section 481T-3 may bring a civil action for appropriate legal and equitable relief, including injunctive relief, and for treble damages, reasonable attorney's fees, filing fees, and costs for the injured party. [L 2020, c 15, pt of §2]
